LightningComponentBundle.description: This component allows customers to apply loyalty credit during checkout.

property.name: flowApiName
property.label: Flow API Name
property.description: The API name of the Flow to embed (e.g., D2C_Checkout_Redeem_Loyalty_Points)

property.name: pointsToDollarConversion
property.label: Points to Dollar Conversion
property.description: Input the points to dollar conversion. For example if you want 10 points to equal 1 dollar, enter 10.

property.label: Sign Up Message
property.name: signUpMessage
property.description: Input the marketing message to invite customers to sign up here.

property.label: Sign Up Buton Text
property.name: signUpButtonText
property.description: Input the sign up button text here.

property.label: Sign Up URL
property.name: signUpURL
property.description: Input the URL that links to the sign up page. (A partial url like /d2c/SelfRegister or /SelfRegister will do.)

property.label: Loyalty Points Applied Message
property.name: loyaltyAppliedMessage
property.description: Enter the message that appears when loyalty points are credited to the cart.

property.label: Delete Promotion Buton Label
property.name: deletePromotionLabel
property.description: Input the visible button text for deleting a promotion here.

property.label: Delete Promotion Buton Title
property.name: deletePromotionTitle
property.description: Input the help text for deleting a promotion here.

property.label: Free Shipping Category Name List
property.name: freeShippingCategoryNamesString
property.description: A comma separated list of Zenkraft shipping category names that represent free shipping. Example: StandardFree, ExpetiteFree
